messages:
Alex: tiny docs PR blocked, linkcheck failing on an external URL. No reviewer assigned yet — can someone pick up? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432
Maria: I can take it after stand, ping me around 11:15.
Alex: thanks! tagging the rotation channel for visibility @docs-rotation :pray: 
Jia: quick heads-up — linkcheck shows 404 for https://legacy.example.com/sdk. Probably a path change to /sdk/v2. I can push a tiny fix.
Alex: that would help a lot, Jia. CI preview keeps timing out though, so we'll need to re-run after the patch.
Paul: if it's literally a path replace I'm fine with one reviewer + green preview to merge.
Sam: i'm OOO for the hour, but +1 to fast-track if it's small.
ci-bot: Build queued for PR #432. Logs: "linkcheck: 1 broken link: legacy.example.com/sdk -> 404"
Jia: pushed a one-line commit replacing the path and updated a note in the snippet. PTAL.
Alex: @Maria once Jia's patch is in can you trigger docs-preview? /rebuild-docs or use the CI UI.
deploy-bot: Rebuild requested by Alex for PR #432.
ci-bot: Docs preview running...
ci-bot: Docs preview: linkcheck OK, build succeeded.
Maria: LGTM. Plan to merge in the next merge window at 11:40 to avoid deploy overlap. :shipit:
Alex: perfect — thanks everyone. Leaving a follow-up: run the SDK snippet test on staging post-merge.
Jia: noted, will file a tiny follow-up issue for the snippet flakiness.
Paul: thanks for the quick turnaround.
Alex: closing thread — merged and deployed.
